players.product: plasma etch tools for 3D NAND and advanced logic (CCP incl. 60:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio dielectric etch; cryogenic high-aspect-ratio ICP etch) plus tungsten CVD / ALD deposition for 3D NAND word lines

quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Yin Zhiyao (Q1 2026 results briefing): Q1 2026 net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 9.30 hundred million, up about 197.20%, on 34.13% revenue growth that added about RMB 2.60 hundred million of gross profit, partly offset by R&D spending up 32.15%, plus an after-tax gain of about RMB 3.97 hundred million from selling part of its Piotech shares. Board secretary Liu Fang said Q1 R&D spending was RMB 9.08 hundred million, 31.14% of revenue, across six categories and more than 20 new tools; the chairman expects the R&D ratio to fall over the long term as revenue grows (leading global peers spend about 12%-13%).
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 net profit RMB 9.30 hundred million (+197.20%); revenue +34.13%; R&D RMB 9.08 hundred million (31.14% of revenue)

quarterly_data.signal: Products and platform (Q1 2026 results briefing): board secretary Liu Fang said the next-generation 90:1 ultra-high-aspect-ratio cryogenic etch tool has shipped to a customer for validation. Chairman Yin Zhiyao said its PECVD tool with a VHF decoupled reactive-ion plasma source and 16 stations has 80% to 100% higher throughput than standard tools and customer validation is going well; its new CuBS PVD multi-chamber tool cuts barrier-seed resistivity and raises throughput by 50% to 100%, and has been delivered to a domestic advanced-logic R&D line; for advanced packaging its CCP and TSV etch tools are in batch delivery, with PVD, CVD, ECP, bonding and metrology tools planned; subsidiary Chaowei is building e-beam metrology and inspection tools; the Chengdu subsidiary will develop and make CVD, ALD and other tools for high-end logic and memory. The acquisition of Hangzhou Zhonggui Electronics by share issue and cash has received CSRC registration approval. About 60%-70% of a new tool's design is now reusable modules, speeding development.
quarterly_data.figure: PECVD throughput +80% to 100%; CuBS PVD throughput +50% to 100%; 90:1 cryogenic etch in validation
